pages.title: Bolingbrook
pages.extract: Bolingbrook is a large suburb of some 70,000 people in Chicagoland.

pages.title: Hillsborough (Northern Ireland)
pages.description: village located in County Down, United Kingdom
pages.extract: Hillsborough is a village historically in County Down in Northern Ireland, nowadays governed as part of Lisburn and Castlereagh District. It's an attractive Georgian village dominated by Hillsborough Castle, the official residence of the Secretary of State for Northern Ireland, and of the King whenever he's in the province. Since 2021 it's been officially dubbed "Royal Hillsborough". It's a commuter town for Belfast, with a population in 2021 of 4200.

pages.title: Nanuet
pages.description: census-designated place in Clarkstown, New York, United States of America
pages.extract: Nanuet is a hamelet of Clarkstown in Rockland County, New York.

pages.title: Sangla
pages.extract: Sangla is a scenic hill village in the Baspa Valley, also known as the Sangla Valley, in Eastern Himachal Pradesh, India, close to the Tibetan border. It's a decent base for exploring the surrounding area, though the village itself isn't overly pleasant.

pages.title: Serra de Tramuntana
pages.description: mountain range in the northwest of Mallorca
pages.extract: Serra de Tramuntana is the region of Mallorca along its northwest coast, named for its mountain chain.

pages.title: Sydney/The Rocks
pages.description: urban locality in Sydney's city centre in New South Wales, Australia

pages.title: Třebíč
pages.extract: Třebíč is a city in the Bohemian-Moravian Highlands of the Czech Republic.

pages.title: Yuanyang
pages.description: county in Yunnan, People's Republic of China
pages.extract: Yuanyang is in Honghe Hani and Yi Autonomous Prefecture of Yunnan, China.

pages.title: Polillo Island
pages.extract: Polillo Island is an island off the coast of eastern Quezon. It is composed of three municipalities, and largely rural area surrounded by rainforest.

pages.title: Tacurong
pages.description: city of the Philippines in the province of Sultan Kudarat
pages.extract: Tacurong is a city in the province of Sultan Kudarat, Philippines.

pages.title: Tabuaço
pages.extract: Tabuaço is a village of 6,350 people (2011) in the Alto Douro wine region of Trás-os-Montes e Alto Douro, northern Portugal.

pages.title: Cotswold Way
pages.extract: The Cotswold Way is a 100-mile (160 km) footpath from Chipping Campden to Bath. It was inaugurated as a National Trail in 2007, and has created a number of new rights of ways.

pages.title: Kalimpong (district)
pages.extract: Kalimpong (Nepali: कालिम्पोङ Kālimpong, Bengali: কালিম্পং Kālimpong) is a Himalayan district of West Bengal, east of Darjeeling and north of Jalpaiguri.

pages.title: Marinha Grande
pages.extract: Marinha Grande is a city in Estremadura, Portugal.

pages.title: Mers-les-Bains
pages.extract: Mers-les-Bains is located on the southernmost tip of the Hauts-de-France coastline. It is a small seaside resort that, together with Le Tréport and Eu, forms a larger urban cluster around the estuary of the Bresle River.

pages.title: Livadeia
pages.description: city and district capital in Boeotia, Greece
pages.extract: Livadia is in West Central Greece. Livadia is a working Greek town with a strong local identity, combining historical layers with a pleasant natural setting. The town's defining feature is the Herkyna River, which flows through a small wooded gorge (the Krya area), creating waterfalls, stone bridges, and shady paths—making it one of the most attractive urban river settings in mainland Greece.
